question: The asthenosphere is a mechanically weak layer beneath which part of Earth? It is characterised by low seismic wave velocities and high attenuation.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lithosphere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Asthenosphere:** The asthenosphere is a mechanically weak and highly viscous layer of the Earth's upper mantle. It lies directly beneath the **lithosphere**, which consists of the crust and the rigid uppermost part of the mantle.
 
• **Seismic Characteristics:** The asthenosphere is characterized by **low seismic wave velocities** and **high attenuation**. This means seismic waves slow down significantly and lose energy as they pass through this layer. This phenomenon occurs due to the presence of partially molten rocks in the asthenosphere.
